content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment transforms how digital creators can sell their work. Traditional platforms often impose high fees—Gumroad, for instance, charges 10% on every sale, while using NOWPayments cuts costs down to just 0.5%. This reduction in fees is crucial for creators aiming to maximize their revenue. By owning your infrastructure, you not only save money but also maintain complete control over your digital products and customer data, ensuring a more sustainable and independent business model.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind automated ebook delivery is straightforward yet powerful. It utilizes free hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, combined with backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Crypto payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept payments seamlessly. Once payment is confirmed on-chain, an automatic webhook triggers the delivery of your ebook. This stack not only enhances efficiency but also sidesteps the limitations imposed by conventional payment platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This automated delivery framework is specifically designed for digital creators in regions with restricted access to conventional payment methods. Whether you sell ebooks, templates, or courses, this infrastructure empowers you to operate independently. By leveraging the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you gain access to all necessary components to create your digital commerce stack. This is particularly valuable for those in countries like Zimbabwe, where traditional payment methods may fail, allowing creators to reclaim their revenue and operate freely.
Automated delivery means instant access for your customers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this architecture include hosting (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), backend processing (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), data storage (Supabase or Google Sheets), file delivery (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2), and payment processing (NOWPayments). Each component plays a critical role in ensuring a smooth transaction and delivery process. The seamless integration of these elements allows for an efficient sales experience without the reliance on conventional platforms, ensuring full ownership and control over your digital products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your automated ebook delivery system, start by selecting a free hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend processing using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Store your orders in Supabase or Google Sheets and prepare your files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Once you have everything configured, you can start selling your ebooks with automated delivery, retaining more of your earnings and ensuring customer satisfaction.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Keep more of your earnings by reducing payment processing fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I automate ebook delivery after crypto payment?

You can automate ebook delivery by setting up a backend script that triggers the delivery process once a payment is confirmed through NOWPayments. This ensures that customers receive their products immediately after successful transactions.
What platforms can I use for hosting my digital products?
You can choose from free hosting options like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both provide reliable services for hosting your digital products without incurring extra costs.
Are there alternatives to PayPal and Stripe for processing payments?
Yes, NOWPayments is an excellent alternative for processing crypto payments without the restrictions of PayPal or Stripe. It supports various cryptocurrencies and has minimal fees.
How do I manage my customer data securely?
You can use platforms like Supabase or Google Sheets to store customer data securely. These platforms allow you to maintain control over your data without relying on external payment gateways.
What is the significance of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments significantly reduces transaction fees compared to traditional platforms. At just 0.5% per transaction, it allows you to retain more revenue from each sale, which is crucial for digital creators.
Full ownership of your digital products and customer data is within reach.
